movies.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "vod_movie"."id", "vod_movie"."uuid", "vod_movie"."name", "vod_movie"."description", "vod_movie"."year", "vod_movie"."rating", "vod_movie"."genre", "vod_movie"."duration_secs", "vod_movie"."logo_id", "vod_movie"."tmdb_id", "vod_movie"."imdb_id", "vod_movie"."language", "vod_movie"."is_adult", "vod_movie"."custom_properties", "vod_movie"."created_at", "vod_movie"."updated_at", "vod_vodlogo"."id", "vod_vodlogo"."name", "vod_vodlogo"."url" FROM "vod_movie" INNER JOIN "vod_m3umovierelation" ON ("vod_movie"."id" = "vod_m3umovierelation"."movie_id") INNER JOIN "m3u_m3uaccount" ON ("vod_m3umovierelation"."m3u_account_id" = "m3u_m3uaccount"."id") LEFT OUTER JOIN "vod_vodlogo" ON ("vod_movie"."logo_id" = "vod_vodlogo"."id") WHERE "m3u_m3uaccount"."is_active" ORDER BY "vod_movie"."name" ASC LIMIT 20

series.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "vod_series"."id", "vod_series"."uuid", "vod_series"."name", "vod_series"."description", "vod_series"."year", "vod_series"."rating", "vod_series"."genre", "vod_series"."logo_id", "vod_series"."tmdb_id", "vod_series"."imdb_id", "vod_series"."language", "vod_series"."custom_properties", "vod_series"."created_at", "vod_series"."updated_at", "vod_vodlogo"."id", "vod_vodlogo"."name", "vod_vodlogo"."url" FROM "vod_series" INNER JOIN "vod_m3useriesrelation" ON ("vod_series"."id" = "vod_m3useriesrelation"."series_id") INNER JOIN "m3u_m3uaccount" ON ("vod_m3useriesrelation"."m3u_account_id" = "m3u_m3uaccount"."id") LEFT OUTER JOIN "vod_vodlogo" ON ("vod_series"."logo_id" = "vod_vodlogo"."id") WHERE "m3u_m3uaccount"."is_active" ORDER BY "vod_series"."name" ASC LIMIT 3

episodes.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "vod_episode"."id", "vod_episode"."uuid", "vod_episode"."name", "vod_episode"."description", "vod_episode"."air_date", "vod_episode"."rating", "vod_episode"."duration_secs", "vod_episode"."series_id", "vod_episode"."season_number", "vod_episode"."episode_number", "vod_episode"."tmdb_id", "vod_episode"."imdb_id", "vod_episode"."custom_properties", "vod_episode"."created_at", "vod_episode"."updated_at", "vod_series"."id", "vod_series"."uuid", "vod_series"."name", "vod_series"."description", "vod_series"."year", "vod_series"."rating", "vod_series"."genre", "vod_series"."logo_id", "vod_series"."tmdb_id", "vod_series"."imdb_id", "vod_series"."language", "vod_series"."custom_properties", "vod_series"."created_at", "vod_series"."updated_at" FROM "vod_episode" INNER JOIN "vod_m3uepisoderelation" ON ("vod_episode"."id" = "vod_m3uepisoderelation"."episode_id") INNER JOIN "m3u_m3uaccount" ON ("vod_m3uepisoderelation"."m3u_account_id" = "m3u_m3uaccount"."id") INNER JOIN "vod_series" ON ("vod_episode"."series_id" = "vod_series"."id") WHERE "m3u_m3uaccount"."is_active" ORDER BY "vod_series"."name" ASC, "vod_episode"."season_number" ASC, "vod_episode"."episode_number" ASC LIMIT 8
